description: Deployment Configuration - Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow, health check/status page component, and deployment documentation.
steps: Create Dockerfile at project root: multi-stage build (node:20-alpine for build, nginx:alpine for serve), copy built assets to nginx, custom nginx.conf for SPA routing (try_files $uri /index.html), expose port 80, healthcheck instruction.
Create docker-compose.yml for local development: app service using the Dockerfile with port 8080:80 mapping, environment variables from .env file, volume mount for live config updates.

Create nginx.conf at project root: gzip compression for text/css/js/json/svg, SPA fallback routing, cache-control headers (immutable for hashed assets, no-cache for index.html), security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, CSP).

Create .github/workflows/ci.yml: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on push/PR to main. Jobs: lint (eslint), test (vitest run), build (vite build), with node 20, npm ci --legacy-peer-deps, caching node_modules.

Create src/pages/StatusPage.jsx - a health check / status page component showing: app version, build timestamp, environment, service worker status, localStorage usage, online/offline status, last API check time. Add route /status in App.jsx.

Update the project README.md (or create DEPLOYMENT.md) with deployment documentation: environment setup, Docker build/run instructions, CI/CD pipeline explanation, environment variables reference, production checklist.
Create src/pages/__tests__/StatusPage.test.jsx testing: renders version info, shows environment, shows online status.
acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile exists with multi-stage build using node:20-alpine and nginx:alpine
nginx.conf has SPA routing, gzip, cache headers, and security headers
StatusPage component renders at /status showing app health info
All tests pass including new StatusPage test
verification: Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run` and confirm all tests pass
Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build` and confirm build succeeds
findings: All 247 tests pass including 5 new StatusPage tests. Build succeeds. StatusPage added as lazy-loaded route at /status. No Docker daemon available to test docker build but Dockerfile syntax is valid.
